criteria.requirement: Implement chardet.files.detect_file(source, *, preserve_position=True, chunk_size=65536, max_bytes=None) on the delivered split-BOM detector. Support text/PathLike paths and caller-owned binary streams, short reads and exact nonnegative byte budgets without lookahead. Restore seekable caller positions on success/failure, never close caller streams, close owned files, and report actual read_bytes/eof/budget_exhausted without claiming an inspected prefix validates the whole file. Zero budget performs no reads; nonseekable preserving mode and text reads fail explicitly.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
